mapper.select: SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM information_schema.schemata WHERE schema_name = 'public') as totalSchemas, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM information_schema.tables WHERE table_schema = 'public') as totalTables, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM information_schema.columns WHERE table_schema = 'public') as totalColumns, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM pg_stat_user_tables WHERE schemaname = 'public' AND n_live_tup = 0) as unusedObjects
SELECT table_schema as "schemaName", table_name as "tableName" FROM information_schema.tables WHERE table_schema = 'public' ORDER BY table_name

SELECT #{table} as tableName, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM "${schema}"."${table}") as rowCount, pg_size_pretty(pg_total_relation_size(quote_ident(#{schema}) || '.' || quote_ident(#{table}))) as tableSize, 'Active' as status, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM pg_indexes WHERE schemaname = #{schema} AND tablename = #{table}) as indexCount
